verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's Terraform/OpenTofu provider lets you manage CKS clusters, VPC networking, object storage policies and Managed Inference resources as code. Those infrastructure definitions can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back in your own source-control and Terraform workflow. The platform itself documents no native versioning, review or rollback of automations, so this relies entirely on external tooling. Missing for 10: native automation version history, a built-in review or approval flow, a documented rollback mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
